transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Okay, morning. Lin, where are we on the cycle rig, still running overnight?

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: Yes. It ran through the night with no faults logged. I stopped it at six to check the coupler, and it looks fine.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Good. Any heat on the motor side?

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: A little warm near the end of the run, but within what we saw last week. I'll pull the thermocouple trace after this.

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: Uh, I've got the second dyno mount torqued down, but the bolt pattern on the adapter plate is off. We had to shim it.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Off how much? Is that a drawing problem or a machining problem?

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: Machining, I think. Holes are fine, the pocket depth is shallow. Jade can you, uh, did that plate come in with an inspection sheet?

transcript.speaker: p-jade
transcript.text: checking the receiving log now one sec

transcript.speaker: p-jade
transcript.text: no sheet came with it just the packing slip

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Fine. Note it and we'll deal with it after the standup. Destiny, anything on the harness side?

transcript.speaker: p-destiny
transcript.text: Two of the long leads have the connector latch cracked 😬 I swapped them out. The rest looked okay, I'm re-pinging the whole run today 🙏

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Good catch. Keep the cracked ones, bag them, I want to see if it's a crimp issue.

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: sorry, sorry, late. can you hear me? my headset died

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: We hear you. Zoe, fixture status?

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: ok so the torque fixture, the clamp is still walking when we go past the mid range. i redid the bushing but i think its the plate not the bushing. thurs maybe, no, wed, i can have a fix

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Wednesday. It's Wednesday now, Zoe.

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: ha. right. eow then

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: hey im here, sory, parking was a nightmare

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: No problem. Luis, did you finish the thermal cover rework?

transcript.speaker: p-luis
transcript.text: yeah done, 2 of 3. the third one has a bent tab i need to straighten, ill do it before lunch

transcript.speaker: p-lin
transcript.text: While we're on thermal, the fan on the chamber is making a noise again. A rattle.

transcript.speaker: p-carlos
transcript.text: That's the same fan we tightened before. I'll look at it, probably the mounting screws backing out.

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: OK. Quick one on parts and then we're done.

transcript.speaker: p-destiny
transcript.text: Do you need me on the shop floor at nine? The fixture cart is in the way 🙏

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Yes please. And Jade, let's chase that order, we need 12 by 11/20, and I want to know if that order is actually moving or just sitting in a queue!!

transcript.speaker: p-jade
transcript.text: ill ask for a status today

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Thanks. Anything else? Zoe, you wanted to say something about the data logger?

transcript.speaker: p-zoe
transcript.text: yeah, the logger drops samples when two channels spike at the same time. im not 100% sure its the logger, might be the cable, uh, ill swap the cable first
